*   **Net Profit Margin:** Net Income / Sales = -952.1 / 2141.2 = -44.5% (2022) vs -518.9/1685.4 = -30.8% (2021).  The net loss margin is significantly worse year-over-year, illustrating severe profitability issues.

**Conclusion:**

While sales growth is a positive indicator, the escalating costs, declining asset values, and, most importantly, the substantial net loss make the overall outlook concerning.  The decreasing margins and increasing debt levels further reinforce this negative sentiment.
